title: Sennheiser Momentum 4 Noise Cancelling Headphones $349 (45% off) or 57510 Qantas Points (55% off) Delivered @ Qantas Marketplace
body:
Deal: Sennheiser Momentum 4 Noise Cancelling Headphones $349 (45% off) or 57510 Qantas Points (55% off) Delivered @ Qantas Marketplace

[silky] Unfortunately not a great deal, these regularly dip to $249 and below. Nice headphones though, I have a pair - but the ANC sucks.
[hollykryten] Could have got the Copper colour for $233.10 a few weeks ago direct from Sennheiser. Now that's a deal.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/966992
[PuppieWayne] Still sad the deal lasted for less than a week
was waiting for my pay check and when it did.. bang! The deal was gone. :(
[hollykryten] Denim colour is the same price at JB if you can find local store stock.
https://www.jbhifi.com.au/products/sennheiser-momentum-wirel…
80th Anniversary Edition is also $349 at JB. That one is like a limited edition.
https://www.jbhifi.com.au/products/sennheiser-momentum-wirel…
[Bargainboss99] Would go cheaper now that the new one is out.
[hollykryten] I can't see the Momentum 5 selling very well with the $749 RRP launch price. That's far higher than the $549.95 RRP that the Momentum 4 had at its launch. It costs more than even the Sony XM6. What is Sennheiser thinking. So people will keep buying the Momentum 4 for some time because the Momentum 5 is way too expensive. So i'm thinking that Sennheiser won't see much reason to clear it out that fast. I'm thinking $350 for this will be the norm for now.
[Maker1] Name one thing that costs the same as 4 years ago lol. All other costs in the global economy have increased, especially the minimum wages in various countries have significantly increased since 2022.
The Momentum 4 is still a very good product so there's really no reason not to get one.
$350 is not a good price for the M4 anyway, they have routinely been selling under $250 lately.
Also, Sennheiser headphones are owned by Sonova. They have just announced they will be selling the brand off. So probably the price increase on products is also an attempt to impress the valuation of the future sale.
[Bargainboss99] I think it will drop mate. This is just fresh dropped price.
[Poimandres] All of these premium headphones are ridiculously priced these days. Sony XMs, Bose Ultras, Apple etc. This should be the standard price.
